clips.end_words: and will give you heart disease
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to a cheese a lot of us grew up on: Kraft American cheese, invented almost a century ago.

His claim: it isn't really cheese. Getting the name on the label took an act of Congress, because the product is mostly oil, spun down into tiny molecules so it melts smooth and silky - the same trick used on Velveeta.

That spinning process is what creates trans fats, also called hydrogenated oil. Kevin Trudeau's view: trans fats didn't exist 90 years ago, and in his view they're one of the things most linked to artery damage today.

Next time you reach for a cheese slice, what does the ingredient list actually say?

#kevintrudeau #transfats #cheese #healthtruth #wbdaily #hearthealth

clips.start_words: When I go to a restaurant
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's habit at every restaurant: order bottled water, not tap, and skip the ice.

City tap water is treated with chlorine to kill bacteria - safe to drink, but it's something he avoids where he can, including the ice at restaurants, since most machines run off the same tap line.

His blind spot for years: he'd drink spring water at home, then order a coffee or tea made with tap water without a second thought. Jarred sauces and coffee-shop drinks carry the same chlorinated water, even when the label never mentions it.

Next time you order, what's actually in your glass?

#kevintrudeau #water #chlorine #healthtruth #wbdaily #wellness

clips.start_words: You know, I have a car
clips.end_words: My body is the same way
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau makes a comparison he's made for years: he takes his car in for a full checkup while it's still running perfectly - brakes, fluids, bearings, tire pressure, everything.

He never waits for a breakdown to look under the hood. By then, he says, a small fix can turn into a big one.

His question: why do most people handle their own body the opposite way, waiting for chest pain or numbness before anyone looks at what's actually happening inside?

A check now, in his view, catches small problems while they're still small - not after they've already become an emergency.

When was the last time you checked something before it broke?

#kevintrudeau #prevention #hearthealth #healthtruth #wbdaily #wellness
